items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Earl Crum and Franklin, Earl's wife and I were making a trip.

ctx.x: Pollock. Pollock. That's what I mean. And he was, uh, he was with that band. In fact, I saw him in, out of Detroit. They were at some nightclub up there. Uh, and that's when Earl Crum and Franklin, Earl's wife and I were making a trip. We went up to, uh, Chicago and all through Minneapolis and went over to, to, uh, Canada. Back down to Pittsburgh, back all the way down here. And, uh, we saw, we saw that, uh, up there.
Uh, but, uh, it was. Was that when you went to the World's Fair or another time?
